title: Dasakam 46 — Viśvarūpadarśanam
description: Yashoda glimpses the universe in child Krishna’s mouth, from an infant’s yawn through the cowherd boys’ accusation and the expanding cosmic vision, before maternal affection returns.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि देव पुरा किल त्वयि
स्वयमुत्तानशये स्तनन्धये ।
परिजृम्भणतो व्यपावृते
वदने विश्वमचष्ट वल्लवी ॥ ४६-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi deva purā kila tvayi
svayamuttānaśaye stanandhaye |
parijṛmbhaṇato vyapāvṛte
vadane viśvamacaṣṭa vallavī || 46-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Once Krishna after taking feed from Yashoda, was lying flat on back on her lap. He yawned and for a moment, Yashoda saw the entire universe in his mouth.

stanzas.sanskrit:
पुनरप्यथ बालकैः समं
त्वयि लीलानिरते जगत्पते ।
फलसञ्चयवञ्चनकृधा
तव मृद्भोजनमूचुरर्भकाः ॥ ४६-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
punarapyatha bālakaiḥ samaṃ
tvayi līlānirate jagatpate |
phalasañcayavañcanakṛdhā
tava mṛdbhojanamūcurarbhakāḥ || 46-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Later, Krishna was playing with his friends. He plucked fruits promising to share it with the friends but cheated them by eating all of them. Angered friends came to mother Yasodha and complained that Krishna ate mud.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि ते प्रलयावधौ विभो
क्षितितोयादिसमस्तभक्षिणः ।
मृदुपाशनतो रुजा भवे-
-दिति भीता जननी चुकोप सा ॥ ४६-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi te pralayāvadhau vibho
kṣititoyādisamastabhakṣiṇaḥ |
mṛdupāśanato rujā bhave-
-diti bhītā jananī cukopa sā || 46-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Bhagwan consumes earth, water and everything during pralaya or deluge.
However Yashoda is innocent of the fact that Krishna is Bhagwan  himself and feared that he will fall sick if he eats mud and got angry for the act.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि दुर्विनयात्मक त्वया
किमु मृत्सा बत वत्स भक्षिता ।
इति मातृगिरं चिरं विभो
वितथां त्वं प्रतिजज्ञिषे हसन् ॥ ४६-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi durvinayātmaka tvayā
kimu mṛtsā bata vatsa bhakṣitā |
iti mātṛgiraṃ ciraṃ vibho
vitathāṃ tvaṃ pratijajñiṣe hasan || 46-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Mother Yashodha repeatedly asked Krishna if he has eaten mud, but Krishna smilingly denied it again and again, very assertively.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अयि ते सकलैर्विनिश्चिते
विमतिश्चेद्वदनं विदार्यताम् ।
इति मातृविभर्त्सितो मुखं
विकसत्पद्मनिभं व्यदारयः ॥ ४६-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ayi te sakalairviniścite
vimatiścedvadanaṃ vidāryatām |
iti mātṛvibhartsito mukhaṃ
vikasatpadmanibhaṃ vyadārayaḥ || 46-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Yashoda told Krishna that all others are confirming that he has eaten mud. She asked him to either accept the mistake or open his mouth and show to her. Krishna opened his mouth slowly, like a lotus in full bloom.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अपि मृल्लवदर्शनोत्सुकां
जननीं तां बहु तर्पयन्निव ।
पृथिवीं निखिलां न केवलं
भुवनान्यप्यखिलान्यदीदृशः ॥ ४६-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
api mṛllavadarśanotsukāṃ
jananīṃ tāṃ bahu tarpayanniva |
pṛthivīṃ nikhilāṃ na kevalaṃ
bhuvanānyapyakhilānyadīdṛśaḥ || 46-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Yashoda wanted to see mud atleast a little bit in his mouth. Krishna did not want to disappoint his mother. So He showed not only the Earth but the entire Universe in his little mouth.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कुहचिद्वनमम्बुधिः क्वचित्
क्वचिदभ्रं कुहचिद्रसातलम् ।
मनुजा दनुजाः क्वचित् सुरा
ददृशे किं न तदा त्वदानने ॥ ४६-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kuhacidvanamambudhiḥ kvacit
kvacidabhraṃ kuhacidrasātalam |
manujā danujāḥ kvacit surā
dadṛśe kiṃ na tadā tvadānane || 46-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Mother Yashoda saw forests, oceans, clouds, skies and rasaathalam in his mouth. One another side, she could see people, asuras, devas.

stanzas.sanskrit:
कलशाम्बुधिशायिनं पुनः
परवैकुण्ठपदाधिवासिनम् ।
स्वपुरश्च निजार्भकात्मकं
कतिधा त्वां न ददर्श सा मुखे ॥ ४६-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kalaśāmbudhiśāyinaṃ punaḥ
paravaikuṇṭhapadādhivāsinam |
svapuraśca nijārbhakātmakaṃ
katidhā tvāṃ na dadarśa sā mukhe || 46-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Not only these, Yashoda saw Lord Sri Hari reclining on the snake bed and lying in the milky ocean in Sri Vaikuntam. At the same time, she also saw him as a small child showing his mouth to her.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विकसद्भुवने मुखोदरे
ननु भूयोऽपि तथाविधाननः ।
अनया स्फुटमीक्षितो भवा-
-ननवस्थां जगतां बतातनोत् ॥ ४६-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vikasadbhuvane mukhodare
nanu bhūyo’pi tathāvidhānanaḥ |
anayā sphuṭamīkṣito bhavā-
-nanavasthāṃ jagatāṃ batātanot || 46-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Yashoda saw all the worlds and Nandagokula, and in that she saw Krishna with mouth wide open and in that again the many worlds and again in it another Nandagokula and the infinitude of the Universe.

stanzas.sanskrit:
धृततत्त्वधियं तदा क्षणं
जननीं तां प्रणयेन मोहयन् ।
स्तनमम्ब दिशेत्युपासजन्
भगवन्नद्भुतबाल पाहि माम् ॥ ४६-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dhṛtatattvadhiyaṃ tadā kṣaṇaṃ
jananīṃ tāṃ praṇayena mohayan |
stanamamba diśetyupāsajan
bhagavannadbhutabāla pāhi mām || 46-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: For a moment, Yashoda gained the enlightenment that Krishna is Paramatma himself. Immediately Krishna showed affection and deluded her to think that he is her son and got on to her lap, asking her to feed him.
